description.value:
Prerequisites: Deadly Lancer class feature

You may opt not to deal extra damage from Deadly Lancer on your dive attack, instead allowing you to make a free trip, bull rush, sunder, or disarm combat maneuver check upon a successful hit. This combat maneuver does not provoke attacks of opportunity, with it still receiving the circumstance attack bonus gained from any altitude differences. You still deal normal damage on this attack.
